label: Widow hypnotized into marriage — worldwide sweep (19 Nov 2026)
description: Worldwide sweep for fiction where a widow is hypnotized (by the man who wants to marry her, or by someone acting for him) into marrying. Each record notes whether she already had children (kids_status / kids_note) and whether the new couple has children (kids_together, pregnancy_outcome / pregnancy_note). Searched the web in English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Indonesian, Filipino, Hindi, Spanish/Portuguese, French/Italian and Russian; TMDB hypnosis × widow keyword intersections; TV Tropes Brainwashed Bride; short-drama aggregators; DLsite's official genre filter (未亡人 × 催眠/洗脳/常識改変) and product API; TikTok/Instagram/YouTube and AI-generated works via web search. Leads already in data.json were skipped without re-checking, at the owner's request. Adults only; anything with minors or unclear adulthood is held in dropped. No new category: records use the existing hypnotized-to-marry, hypnotized-marriage and widow-divorcee categories. Appended at the end of SOURCES so existing IDs don't shift.

records.title: 親戚のおばさんが嫁を探せとうるさいので俺の嫁にした
records.meta: Manga · Japan · Japanese · circle 箱舟 (Hakobune) · DLsite RJ281617 / FANZA d_174625 · released 19 Mar 2020 · 25 pages · R18 · genres 熟女, 未亡人, 催眠 (トランス/暗示), 寝取り
records.character: The protagonist's widowed relative (親戚のおばさん), a mature woman
records.summary: Official copy: in a remote countryside village with no young women, the man's widowed older relative keeps nagging him to find a bride, so he makes her his bride instead ("嫁探しは身近な熟女!"). The official genres list 未亡人 (widow) and 催眠 (hypnosis); other store listings tag it トランス/暗示 (trance/suggestion), i.e. she is hypnotized into becoming his wife.
records.hypnotist: The man who wants to marry her (her younger relative)
records.method: Hypnosis / trance suggestion (per official genre tags)
records.gain_motive: A wife (no young women in the village)
records.married_note: Title: 俺の嫁にした ("I made her my bride/wife").
records.kids_note: Prior children from her late husband: not stated in the official listing.
records.kids_together_note: Children with the new husband: not stated.
records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy is mentioned in the official listing (no 妊娠/孕ませ genre).
